item.title: Garmin Cirqa Imminent: Two Major Sports Tech Drops Next Week
item.description: Strong independent signals point to a Garmin announcement next week — and all evidence points to Cirqa, Garmin's screenless Whoop rival. A second major brand is also revealing a new running watch. Here is what we know.

item.title: Garmin Smart Swim Goggles with microLED projection: Teased or Just FORM?
item.description: A Garmin triathlon video appears to show HUD-equipped swim goggles — but a key hardware detail doesn't match FORM's design. Are these simply FORM goggles shot at an odd angle, or is Garmin testing something new?

item.title: New Amazfit Helio Strap Lengths - boost accuracy with improved wear position
item.description: Amazfit has launched two new Helio Strap biceps bands for the US market: Charcoal Black and Light Gray. Both fit upper arms from 270 to 420 mm and position the BioTracker sensor higher for cleaner workout data. Priced at $19.99 each.

item.title: Rack Strength app: for Garmin: Real-Time Strength Tracking
item.description: Garmin's native strength mode logs a timer. Rack fixes that — syncing directly with your watch over Bluetooth in real-time to track every set, PR, and recovery pattern. This is what Garmin never built.

item.title: Crystal Reborn - Garmin Watch Face — 1M Downloads, Rebuilt
item.description: The original Crystal watch face hit one million downloads and won Garmin's Best New Watch Face. Now it has been rebuilt from scratch. Body Battery, full-colour AOD, OpenWeather, and 30+ complications.

item.title: Strava: The Nuclear Carrier Is Over Here - Come and Get It - A Pattern of leaks
item.description: A French sailor's 36-minute deck run just broadcast a nuclear carrier's real-time position in a war zone. This is not the first time Strava has done this. It will not be the last.

item.title: Amazfit T-Rex Ultra 2 Review: Out-Maps Instinct 3, Under-Prices Garmin Fenix
item.description: Detailed accuracy tests, GPS distance data, and real-world usability from weeks of use. The T-Rex Ultra 2 beats the Instinct 3 on maps and matches it on price. Here is whether it is worth your money.

item.title: KICKR HEADWIND Firmware 2.0.43: Multi-Sensor Cooling Update
item.description: Wahoo has released firmware 2.0.43 for the KICKR HEADWIND, the fan's most significant update since its 2018 launch. New sensor types are supported alongside an adaptive multi-sensor cooling mode. Here's what changed and how the update went in practice.

item.title: Pirelli P Zero Race TLR SL-R: First Impressions After 100 Miles - Their Fastest Road Tyre?
item.description: Pirelli launches its most aerodynamically advanced road tyre yet. After 100 miles on the SL-R, including back-to-back comparisons with the Continental Aero 111, here are my honest first impressions.

item.title: Garmin Connect+ Expansion: Bad News for Strength App
item.description: Garmin's Connect+ subscription is building a native strength ecosystem — and the API restrictions that blocked Hevy are no accident. We examine the technical evidence and what Garmin is planning next.
